text:
deploy-bot: Deployment blocked: release v1.13.2 -> prod. Preflight check failed: config-schema mismatch: inference.runtime.thread_pool_size present in prod overlay but missing from staging overlay. See /deploy/errors/8b2d.

harper: ack. That key affects runtime threading and autoscaler SLOs. If staging doesn't have it, prod could behave differently. Where does that key originate?

lucas: It was added in infra chart commit 12f4a0 to support hot path routing for model shards. Staging overlay didn't pick up the new defaults because the staging-helm-values.yaml still references legacy-values: true.

tess: two remediation options: 1) backfill staging overlay with thread_pool_size and mirror prod autoscaler annotations (quick), 2) revert the infra chart change from 12f4a0 for this release (slower; requires coordination with infra team), 3) proceed with an explicit runtime flag at deploy time to set thread_pool_size=auto on prod (risky).

harper: given daylight hours and a change window that closes in 1hr 20m, option 1 seems best. Backfill staging to match prod, re-run preflight, smoke test. Add a note to the release notes: "Staging overlay backfilled for thread_pool_size parity."

lucas: I'm on it. Patch will add:
```yaml
# overlays/staging/patch-threadpool.yaml
inference:
  runtime:
    thread_pool_size: 64
autoscaler:
  annotations:
    target-rps: "1200"
```

infra-runner: Reminder: after patching, also update the staging k8s rollout strategy to use maxUnavailable: 1 to avoid mass disruption during smoke tests.

lucas: patch applied, preflight re-run requested (run id: 9d7e).

deploy-bot: Preflight rerun started (9d7e-r1).

lucas: preflight passed. Started smoke tests (cache warming, approximate-latency tests, and sanity logs check).

tess: smoke tests: cache warmup ok, latency slightly higher by ~12ms but within SLO. That delta is likely from thread_pool increase. Documented in release notes.

harper: decision: proceed with prod promote. We'll pin grpc-serving image to `grpc-2026-03-20` to lock runtime behaviour. Release notes will mention the staging backfill, image pin, and the small expected latency delta.

deploy-bot: Promotion to prod started. Will post success/failure.

infra-runner: post-deploy note: schedule a follow-up review with infra next week to ensure default Helm values are propagated to staging during chart bumps.

lucas: merging release notes and tagging release `v1.13.2-prod-20260321`. Monitoring oncall notified.

deploy-bot: Promotion succeeded. Release deployed to prod. Closing thread.
